actualInventory.fallbackGoal: Opit sijoittamaan negatiiviset luvut lukusuoralle nollan vasemmalle puolelle.

why: Positiivinen luku on suurempi kuin negatiivinen.
−3 on lähempänä nollaa, joten se on suurempi kuin −5.

order.explain: Pienin on se, joka on lukusuoralla kauimpana vasemmalla: −5.

why.s0: Pienin on −6: se on kauimpana vasemmalla.
why.s3: Suurin on 2: se on kauimpana oikealla.

sort.hint: Mitä kauempana nollasta vasemmalla, sitä pienempi luku. −8 on pienempi kuin −2.

place.hint: Negatiiviset luvut ovat nollan vasemmalla puolella.

why: Katso, kummalla puolella nollaa sammakko on.

read.hint: Onko sammakko nollan vasemmalla vai oikealla? Laske askeleet nollasta.

transfer.say: Sukeltaja on kohdassa −3 metriä. Hän sukeltaa 2 metriä syvemmälle. Napauta, missä hän on nyt.

whyAt.5: Sukeltaja on pinnan alla, joten luku on negatiivinen.
whyAt.-1: Syvemmälle on lukusuoralla vasemmalle, ei oikealle.
whyAt.-3: Tämä on lähtökohta. Sukella vielä syvemmälle.

transfer.hint: Lähde kohdasta −3 ja hyppää 2 askelta vasemmalle.

why: Positiivinen luku on suurempi kuin negatiivinen.
−2 on lähempänä nollaa, joten se on suurempi kuin −5.

actualInventory.registry: Direct NodeSpec plus actual index/families inspection: no SIMS entry for these IDs; own AUDIT_REV; GOALS fallback if undefined.

familyTreatment.place: Place a target −7..−1 on the line.
familyTreatment.read: Read r.int(−7,7)||−3: zero is excluded by fallback.
familyTreatment.order: Choose smallest among signed integers; source feedback can call zero positive.
familyTreatment.sort: Place ordered signed integers on a line; hints left-to-right.
familyTreatment.transfer: Depth change from a negative height, explicit surface reference.

demos: −4 and +4 opposite sides at equal distance, −6<−2<3, diver −2−3=−5.

introAndReward.intro: Ice number line; negatives left of zero.
introAndReward.ownTreatment: Retain signed-position purpose; omit reward wording asserting established skill.
introAndReward.hintExplainInventory: Exact sampled family hint/explanation retained in actualInventory.sample; all source branches independently read in saari1.ts.

animations.actualRead: Full relevant helper geometry/captions/phase logic read. Source iceHops uses timed .55-second steps; own manual steps depict unit intervals, not elapsed time. coordWalk traces x then y and shows region/sign labels.
animations.ownTreatment: Free marker movement with unit-interval arcs, independent reading/placement and depth example.
animations.limits: No copied art, no runtime oracle or generic KC/game mapping change.

registry.index: CONTENT_REV fallback; own AUDIT_REV preserved; own missing goal supplied from GOALS.
registry.families: No targeted family override for own node.
registry.SIMS: Neither own node in SIMS; no .6/.35/.5 overlay inherited.
registry.coverage: COVERAGE omits sort and lists two rather than actual three demos.

audit.relevant: Own rows and detailed iceHops/sort or coordWalk/sortQ review, around lines587–600. PEDAGOGY_REFERENCES and engine/types read.
audit.limits: Inherited technical checks are historical; no efficacy/human approval transferred.

alignment.comparison: Use concrete height and equal intervals before signed notation checks. Free construction/reading, zero and positive positions supplement Lite negative placement. Order comparison taught with explained figures instead of another mandatory recognition gate.
reconciliations: Exact source guided seed3 order has options0,−5,−2 and feedback for0 calls it positive; own teaching explicitly says zero is neither positive nor negative. Read zero coverage restored.
alignment.limits: Immutable Lite/graph preserved. No full process rubric, retention or independent learner evidence.
